name: Notion — hosted MCP server
description: Notion's hosted MCP server, over OAuth. Notion scopes access to the pages a person picks at the consent screen rather than to their whole workspace, which is the one vendor here whose own consent step narrows reach.

hosts.why: The MCP server itself. Every tool call this connector brokers is dialled here.
The OAuth token endpoint. Dialled server-side, carrying this deployment's client secret, on every code exchange and refresh.

connector.description: Notion, over its hosted MCP server
